text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we need a short deprecation notice + migration guide for v1 -> v2. Found a few quirky SDK behaviors and one broken TS snippet when swapping embed models. Can we coordinate PRs and a rollback plan? Target date: next Tue for the public notice.

Marisol Rivera: I can take the migration guide draft. Do we want a single page or separate quickstart + deep dive? :thinking_face:

Jordan Patel: Quickstart + short FAQ makes sense. Keep it <500 words for the top of the doc. Deep dive can live under /guides/migration.

Liam O'Neil: Noted one SDK gotcha: v2 client now throws on unknown params instead of ignoring them. Broke a few examples that pass `model: 'gpt-old'` via alias. We should add a small compatibility section and example shim.

Sophie Grant: Found the broken TS snippet in the embeddings doc — the `dimension` param name changed in v2. Current snippet:```ts
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: "rwd-embed-v1", input: "text" })
console.log(res.dimension)
```This errors because it's `embedding.length` now. I'll open a PR to fix the snippet and add a note in the changelog. :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: @Sophie thanks. Please also add a tiny test in the snippets smoke suite so we catch that automatically.

Marisol Rivera: For the deprecation notice copy: propose short bullets — timeline, impact (API + SDK behavior), links to migration quickstart, and rollback instructions for Dedicated customers. I'll draft and post later today.

Jordan Patel: For rollback: recommend a customer-facing pattern — pin old model alias + set routing to dedicated pool until they migrate. We should include exact `curl` and SDK examples:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-gen-v1-compat","input":"x"}'
```and a Typescript example for pinning.

Liam O'Neil: Also call out latency regression possibility when switching to quantized v2 variants. Add the perf note and a link to the Optimize guide.

Sophie Grant: PRs I plan: docs/snippets/embeddings-fix (TS/py), docs/migration/quickstart-draft. I'll tag reviewers.

Docs Bot: PR opened by Sophie on branch `docs/emb-fix-3111` (#4120) — pre-commit checks passed.

Alex Chen: Great. Assign reviewers: @Marisol for tone and rollout copy, @Jordan for rollback examples, @Liam for technical accuracy. Can we have PRs ready for review by EOD Fri?

Marisol Rivera: I can review Friday morning. If anything blocks the public notice, we'll hold the announcement until fixes merge and snippets verified by smoke tests.

Deploy Bot: Staging snippet smoke tests scheduled for 3111160000. Will report back with failures.

Jordan Patel: One more edge: alias mapping for embeddings — old alias names might map to different dims in v2. Add a migration step: run `client.embeddings.checkAlias("alias")` (pseudo) and validate dims before swapping in prod.

Liam O'Neil: I'll add a short checklist to the migration guide with commands, test steps, and a rollback snippet.

Alex Chen: Perfect. Thanks team — Sophie please post links to the draft PRs here when ready, and we'll sync up in the docs channel Friday if needed. :rocket:
